_source: docs/design-bible.md: Room layouts. Proposed values; edit freely.

shapes.name: Hex hall
shapes.description: One large hexagon, with columns lining the walls.

shapes.name: Column forest
shapes.description: An open floor crowded with basalt columns of uneven heights.

shapes.name: Split chamber
shapes.description: Two halves joined by a narrow bridge or a gap to jump.

shapes.name: Ring
shapes.description: A circular path around a central pit, pillar or dais.

shapes.name: Switchback
shapes.description: A zigzag room that doubles back on itself, like a maze in miniature.

shapes.name: Tiered stair
shapes.description: Three or four levels of stepped column tops.

shapes.name: Honeycomb
shapes.description: A cluster of small hex cells joined by gaps.

shapes.name: Twisted vault
shapes.description: Features hang from the ceiling as often as they rise from the floor.

elevations.name: Columns of varied heights to climb

lighting.name: Flickering: alternates dim and dark each round

terrain.name: Low columns
terrain.effect: Half cover.

terrain.name: Tall columns
terrain.effect: Full cover; climbing one is a DC 12 Athletics check.

terrain.name: Broken column field
terrain.effect: Difficult terrain.

terrain.name: Fissure
terrain.effect: A 5 ft wide crack running across the room, 15 ft deep.

terrain.name: Hex dais
terrain.effect: A raised platform that grants high ground.

terrain.name: Transit rune pair
terrain.effect: Once per round, a creature on one rune can spend 5 ft of movement to teleport to the other.

terrain.name: Gate-glass shards
terrain.effect: Difficult terrain; moving through at full speed deals 1d4 piercing damage per 5 ft.

terrain.name: Collapsed archway
terrain.effect: A 10 ft choke point.

terrain.name: Shrine to Thils
terrain.effect: Offerings and candles; locals would be furious if it were damaged.

terrain.name: Strider remains
terrain.effect: A lost traveler's gear, worth a search for loot.

terrain.name: Hanging cables
terrain.effect: Climbable lines from the old gate; they swing a creature 15 ft as part of its move.

terrain.name: Polished floor
terrain.effect: Creatures that Dash make a DC 12 Dexterity save or fall prone.

terrain.name: Rotating column ring
terrain.effect: At initiative 20, a ring of columns turns 30 degrees.

terrain.name: Narrow catwalk
terrain.effect: A 5 ft walkway over a 20 ft drop.

terrain.name: Echoing chamber
terrain.effect: Sound carries: no one can take the Hide action.

terrain.name: False wall
terrain.effect: A hidden passage found with a DC 15 Investigation check.

terrain.name: Dead-end alcoves
terrain.effect: Small nooks that offer full cover but trap whoever hides there.

terrain.name: Pool of raw stride energy
terrain.effect: Difficult terrain dealing PB force damage to creatures starting a turn in it.

terrain.name: Inverted overgrowth
terrain.effect: Grass and vines grow from the ceiling down, lightly obscuring the area.

terrain.name: Roll twice
terrain.effect: Combine both features.
